title: 第十二章 懊悔第十三章 小狼
lines: 第十二章懊悔
卖血？
叶欢竟然去卖血？难道这顿饭是他卖血请我们吃的吗？
慕容小开不明白，是表姐让叶欢请客的啊，怎么会不知道他没钱？居然还让他卖血来请客？
“小开，你不是借了我一张十万的银行卡？”墨青语连忙抬起头，抱着最后一丝希望问道。
“哦，那张银行卡？”慕容小开突然想了起来，十分抱歉的说道：“对不起啊，表姐，那张银行卡是我老爸，他生意出了问题，银行卡也被冻结了，我之前忘了告诉你了。”
冻结？
冻结了？
墨青语明白了，全明白了！
叶欢没有钱，去卖血，为了还自己的钱。
而自己却硬拉着叶欢，为自己的生日请客，一顿饭吃了他好几千块钱！
甚至还故意点了一瓶很贵的红酒，故意气叶欢，让他花钱！
自己还是人吗？这得需要他卖多少血才能补回来啊？
可是自己还不停地讥笑他，笑他太小气，太吝啬，甚至后来还冤枉他是变态流氓！
可是他从来没有抱怨过，从来没有解释过，就连自己打他的一巴掌，他都没有躲，只是默默地承受。
这是怎样一个男人啊，墨青语想到叶欢离开时的眼神，那个深深地眼神，一眼千年！
伤心，自责，痛苦，懊悔……所有难受的情绪都涌上墨青语心头，简直比死了还难受。
“叶欢，对不起，对不起！”墨青语大声地哭喊着，要将心头的情绪都发泄出来。
“表姐，别这样，都是我的错……”慕容小开也猜到了一些，也忍不住哭了起来。
她一直看不起叶欢，对于表姐嫁给叶欢耿耿于怀，认为是叶欢糟蹋的表姐。
没想到他是这样伟大的男人，慕容小开想象不到，世界上居然有这么胸怀宽广的男人。
如果有哪个男人愿意为自己这么做，自己就算死也愿意嫁给他吧。可惜这个男人是自己姐夫，慕容小开心思百转。
饭店经理也不知道发生了什么，这两个漂亮得不像话的女人就这么哭了起来，一时间也有些手足无措。
还好带她们到包间里来了，要是在大厅就麻烦了，饭店经理暗自庆幸道。
“手链，我要找我的手链……”墨青语突然哭着站了起来，四处张望着要找手链。
“小姐，我们真的没有看到您的手链，也许被扫地阿姨当做垃圾扔了，都倒在饭店背后的垃圾堆了吧……”
砰！
饭店经理的话还没说完，墨青语已经夺门而出，冲出了饭店。
桂云大山后面是无尽的山脉，叶欢往里面走了好几天。
叶欢的速度很快，这一天一夜，他估计已经不少距离了。
还好他准备好了必要的工具，饿了的时候他就直接抓一只野兔之类的。
嗯，他还还准备了调料，配上他的手艺，也是一顿不错的野味。
也许还没有到深处，所以叶欢也没有寻到什么灵物。
嗯？
忽然一阵灵气的波动传来，叶欢连忙赶过去，原来是一个灵眼。
这种灵眼会将周围的灵气都汇集在这里，时间久了就会形成灵石。
content_en:
Chapter 12 Regret
Selling blood?
Ye Huan actually went to sell blood? Could it be that he sold his blood to treat us to this meal?
Murong Xiaokai didn't understand. It was her cousin who asked Ye Huan to treat her. How could she not know that he had no money? He actually asked him to sell his blood to treat guests?
"Xiao Kai, didn't you lend me a bank card worth RMB 100,000?" Mo Qingyu quickly raised her head and asked with her last glimmer of hope.
"Oh, that bank card?" Murong Xiaokai suddenly remembered and said very apologetically: "I'm sorry, cousin, that bank card belongs to my father. There was a problem with his business and the bank card was frozen. I forgot to tell you before."
Freeze?
Frozen?
Mo Qingyu understood, understood everything!
Ye Huan had no money, so he sold blood to pay back his own money.
But he forced Ye Huan to treat him for his birthday and cost him thousands of dollars for a meal!
He even ordered a bottle of very expensive red wine on purpose to annoy Ye Huan and make him spend money!
Are you still a human being? How much blood does he need to sell to make up for it?
But I kept laughing at him, laughing at him for being too stingy and stingy, and even later unjustly accused him of being a perverted hooligan!
But he never complained, never explained, and even when he slapped him, he didn't hide, he just endured it silently.
What kind of man is this? Mo Qingyu thought of Ye Huan's eyes when he left, that deep look that lasted a thousand years!
Sadness, self-blame, pain, regret...all the uncomfortable emotions rushed into Mo Qingyu's heart, and it was simply worse than death.
"Ye Huan, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!" Mo Qingyu cried loudly, trying to vent all the emotions in his heart.
"Cousin, don't be like this, it's all my fault..." Murong Xiaokai also guessed something and couldn't help crying.
She has always looked down upon Ye Huan, and was very resentful about her cousin marrying Ye Huan, thinking that Ye Huan was a spoiled cousin.
I didn't expect him to be such a great man. Murong Xiaokai couldn't imagine that there was such a broad-minded man in the world.
If there is a man who is willing to do this for me, I will marry him even if I die. It's a pity that this man is his brother-in-law, Murong Xiaoxin is thinking all over the place.
The hotel manager didn't know what happened, but these two incredibly beautiful women just started crying, and they were a little at a loss for a while.
Fortunately, we brought them to the private room. It would have been troublesome if they were in the lobby. The hotel manager secretly rejoiced.
"Bracelet, I'm looking for my bracelet..." Mo Qingyu suddenly cried and stood up, looking around for the bracelet.
"Miss, we really didn't see your bracelet. Maybe it was thrown away by the sweeper as trash and dumped in the trash behind the hotel..."
Bang!
Before the hotel manager finished speaking, Mo Qingyu had already rushed out of the door and rushed out of the hotel.
…
Behind Guiyun Mountain are endless mountains, and Ye Huan walked inside for several days.
Ye Huan's speed was very fast. In this day and night, he probably covered a lot of distance.
Fortunately, he had prepared the necessary tools. When he was hungry, he would just catch a hare or something.
Well, he also prepared seasonings, and with his skills, it was also a good game meal.
Maybe he hasn't reached the depths yet, so Ye Huan didn't find any spiritual objects.
Um?
Suddenly a wave of spiritual energy came, and Ye Huan hurried over. It turned out to be a spiritual eye.
This kind of spiritual eye will gather all the surrounding spiritual energy here, and over time, spiritual stones will be formed.
